responsibility: This Texinfo source contains the detailed user documentation for GNU Fortran intrinsic procedures and intrinsic modules. It provides the alphabetical intrinsic reference included into the main gfortran manual, covering semantics, standard status, arguments, and module-provided facilities such as IEEE, OpenMP, and OpenACC-related intrinsic interfaces.
same_name_distinction: Provides the user-facing reference manual for intrinsic procedures and intrinsic modules, intended to be included into the main GNU Fortran manual. Unlike gcc/fortran/intrinsic.cc and gcc/fortran/intrinsic.h, it documents intrinsic behavior instead of implementing or declaring the compiler’s intrinsic-handling code.
